title: Universal source arrows induce normalized maps of Isom presheaves
statement: Let Y be a scheme and q:R→S a homomorphism of commutative coefficient rings. Given C,K over R and Cprime,Kprime over S, and specified arrows dC:C→Res Cprime, dK:K→Res Kprime, assume [def-weil-pbc-etale-universal-normalization] for each. There exists a natural map p between the actual etale source-site Isom presheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-local-isomorphism-sheaf] satisfying e.hom followed by the pulled dK equals the pulled dC followed by Res(p(e).hom), on every etale object and for every local isomorphism e. No coefficient finiteness, boundedness, stalk or covering assumption is needed.

source.place: Tag 09C6, finite quotient levels and the normalized algebraic diagram; Tags 06YY and 09BV.

proof.text: At U construct normalizationUniversalIso privately: its forward and inverse maps are the unique factors through the two universal arrows. Their composites are identities by hom_ext. The private normalizationUniversalIso_fac is exactly fac, and gives its normalization equation. These elementary comma-category proofs require no downstream transport module.

For f:U→V apply the privately proved normalizationSquareTransport to the etale coefficient mate and the two restriction-coherence equations. Its proof is cancellation of the comparison isomorphisms followed by functoriality and naturality of the mate. It shows that restricting the transported isomorphism solves the normalization square on U. Universality on U and hom_ext identify it with transport of the restricted isomorphism, proving presheaf naturality.
Use these pointwise transports as the components of a natural transformation. Their factorization equations are exactly the required generator normalization equations.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleUniversalNormalization_presheaf (Y : Scheme.{t})
    {R S : Type (t + 1)} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (q : R →+* S)
    (C K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{t + 1} R)))
    (C' K' : DerivedCategory (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{t + 1} S)))
    (dC : C ⟶ (normalizationRestrict Y.smallEtaleTopology q).obj C')
    (dK : K ⟶ (normalizationRestrict Y.smallEtaleTopology q).obj K')
    (hC : EtaleUniversalNormalization Y q dC) (hK : EtaleUniversalNormalization Y q dK) :
    ∃ p : derivedLocalIsomorphismPresheaf C K ⟶ derivedLocalIsomorphismPresheaf C' K',
      ∀ (U : Y.Etale) (e : (localIsomorphismRestriction Y R U).obj C ≅
          (localIsomorphismRestriction Y R U).obj K),
        e.hom ≫ etaleIsomorphismNormalizationArrow Y q dK U =
          etaleIsomorphismNormalizationArrow Y q dC U ≫
            (normalizationRestrict U.left.smallEtaleTopology q).map
              (p.app (op U) e).hom
